verdict.rationale: Fellow documents an API-key-authenticated REST Developer API that scripts can drive without the UI: reading transcripts and notes, writing note agendas, managing action items, uploading recordings and polling their processing status. That supports headless automation, though nothing addresses CI pipelines specifically. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration/docs, a sandbox or test workspace for non-production runs, a published OpenAPI download path or changelog, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
